predictions.why: The mechanism is about Code 3.0's truncation-masked runaway generation and says nothing about selecting among cued-base samples, so this uses the base rates for the same 4 stored samples (vote 446, ties to the shortest sample 453, pass@4 467): short answers from the cued base are rarely wrong and cap hits are dropped, so short-3@4 should land close to the shortest-tie vote.
